  createService(
    name: $name
    ownerId: $ownerId
    environmentId: $environmentId
    type: $type
    repo: $repo
    image: $image
    registryCredentialId: $registryCredentialId
    branch: $branch
    rootDir: $rootDir
    runtime: $runtime
    buildCommand: $buildCommand
    startCommand: $startCommand
    dockerfilePath: $dockerfilePath
    buildFilter: $buildFilter
    plan: $plan
    autoDeploy: $autoDeploy
    schedule: $schedule
    command: $command
    publishPath: $publishPath
    port: $port
    envVars: $envVars
    secretFiles: $secretFiles
  ) {
    id
    name
    type
    phase
    projectId
    environmentId
    registryCredentialId
    latestDeployId
    __typename
  }
}

native.method: Ordinary certificate-verified HTTPS URLs without Host override, insecure TLS, forced DNS or local request/response interception. Each curl subprocess is fresh; the second 12-request batch is a fresh Python process. The independent Go client preserves URL/Request.Host and negotiates HTTP/2.0.

representationNotes: Native no-Accept-Encoding reads return the 1548-byte identity representation. Browser response.text is decoded; the extra fresh-browser response directly observes br and compressed Content-Length589 with the same decoded sample, so its header length is not treated as the decoded body length.

sourceResearch.meaning: Incoming lookup and every effective-host map key are lowercased; published/suspended filtering remains.
GET/HEAD method gate and host-only lookup; no path normalization change.
Real-handler CachedResolver regression covers eight host/alias spellings including ports, three case-distinct object paths, HEAD, unknown host and method405.
Existing independent HEAD test asserts status200 and empty body.

tests.limitations: No source/test change in this acceptance. Historical implementation make test/make lint results remain historical; they were not rerun here.

recipes.curl:
from pathlib import Path
import datetime, hashlib, json, re, subprocess, sys, tempfile

phase = sys.argv[1]
assert phase in ['initial', 'repeat']
hosts = ['qa-20261017-a897-hostcase.onbex.co', 'QA-20261017-A897-HOSTCASE.ONBEX.CO', 'Qa-20261017-A897-HostCase.OnBex.Co']
expected = Path('examples/static-site/index.html').read_bytes()
rows = []
for mode in ['default', 'http1.1']:
    for host in hosts:
        for method in ['GET', 'HEAD']:
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='qa-a897-') as td:
                p = Path(td)
                cmd = ['curl', '--disable', '--silent', '--show-error', '--verbose', '--connect-timeout', '5', '--max-time', '20', '--dump-header', str(p/'headers'), '--output', str(p/'body'), '--write-out', '%{http_code}']
                if mode == 'http1.1': cmd += ['--http1.1']
                if method == 'HEAD': cmd += ['--head']
                url = 'https://' + host + '/'
                at = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
                r = subprocess.run(cmd + [url], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=25)
                body = (p/'body').read_bytes() if (p/'body').exists() else b''
                # curl --head writes response headers to its output file, not a response body.
                if method == 'HEAD': body = b''
                raw = (p/'headers').read_text() if (p/'headers').exists() else ''
                headers = {}
                for line in raw.splitlines():
                    if ':' in line:
                        k, v = line.split(':', 1)
                        if k.lower() in ['content-type', 'content-length', 'etag', 'last-modified', 'allow', 'location', 'server', 'date']:
                            headers[k.lower()] = v.strip()
                wire = re.findall(r'(?im)^(?:> Host: |\* \[HTTP/2\].*\[:authority: )([^\]\r\n]+)', r.stderr)
                protocols = re.findall(r'(?m)^< (HTTP/\S+)', r.stderr)
                status = int(r.stdout) if r.stdout.isdigit() else None
                rows.append({'at': at, 'request': {'method': method, 'url': url, 'mode': mode, 'wireHosts': wire}, 'exitCode': r.returncode, 'response': {'status': status, 'protocols': protocols, 'headers': headers, 'body': body.decode('utf-8'), 'bodyBytes': len(body), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()}, 'transportError': r.stderr if r.returncode else None, 'checks': {'success': r.returncode == 0 and status == 200, 'wireCaseRetained': host in wire, 'content': body == (b'' if method == 'HEAD' else expected), 'contentTypeHtml': headers.get('content-type','').startswith('text/html'), 'contentLength1548': headers.get('content-length') == '1548'}})
out = {'pass': 'a897', 'phase': phase, 'expected': {'bytes': len(expected), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest()}, 'receipts': rows, 'allPassed': all(all(r['checks'].values()) for r in rows)}
Path('.playwright-mcp/qa-a897-native-'+phase+'.json').write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'phase': phase, 'requests':len(rows), 'statuses':[r['response']['status'] for r in rows], 'allPassed':out['allPassed'], 'failed': [{'request':r['request'],'checks':r['checks']} for r in rows if not all(r['checks'].values())]}))
